scope: Reconcile current primary-source DXF/ACIS carrier, parser, projection and consumer documentation with live open-source peer issue/PR status, then refine existing 3D implementation and comparator gates.

method.kind: Read-only web-source research plus local plan/source/receipt cross-check
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md already separates explicit geometry, modeler payload carriers, AcDs association, bounded parsers, semantic geometry, and native consumer evidence under existing S2/S3/S5/S8 owners.
DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md is an implementation-status rollup; its latest header summary was refreshed to point to this reconciliation.
Existing repo guidance requires generated/ephemeral test inputs where suitable and no speculative ACIS semantic support claims.
method.evidenceRule: Primary docs define their own route and stated limits; mutable issue/PR pages are status snapshots, not immutable release behavior. Peer reports do not prove an analogous local defect. Opaque carrier survival, typed topology, geometry semantics, writer acceptance and native-consumer behavior remain separate evidence grades.

evidence.topic: Autodesk DXF modeler entity fields do not define inner ACIS semantics
evidence.observed: The documented 3DSOLID fields include the AcDbModelerGeometry subclass, group 70 modeler-format value, proprietary group 1 and continuation group 3, plus group 350 soft-owner history handle. The page does not specify the inner ACIS/SAB grammar or establish validity of the body.
doesNotEstablish: the SAT/SAB inner dialect based on DXF group 70
evidence.planUse: Retain repeated carrier order, subtype, history-handle closure, version-specific carrier location and semantic-body status as separate fields.

evidence.topic: ezdxf 1.4.5 current SAT/SAB API and bounded semantic capability
evidence.observed: The current API documents load_dxf/export_dxf and separate export_sat/export_sab functions; SAT ACIS 700 is documented for DXF R2000-R2010, while SAB ACIS 21800 is documented for R2013/R2018. Current API docs therefore supersede the older FAQ's SAT-only wording for API availability. The API warns unsupported ACIS records become NONE_ENTITY and lose data; mesh_from_body covers flat polygonal faces only and no general ACIS kernel is supplied.
doesNotEstablish: curved-surface tessellation or general B-rep validity
that an exact locally generated DXF output was executed in this pass
evidence.planUse: Admit the pinned 1.4.5 route only as an optional matching-profile carrier/control author and bounded flat-polyhedron parser/projection. Require a generated exact-version smoke test before relying on emitted bytes; record unsupported/lost body entities and keep geometry expectations independent.

evidence.topic: GDAL DXF binary, ASM and output-version boundaries
evidence.observed: The current docs state binary DXF read support starting with GDAL 3.12. 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SURFACE are skipped by default; DXF_3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes raw ASM bytes and a 12-value column-major transform only for AC1027+ and does not create OGR solids. The DXF writer emits AC2004.
doesNotEstablish: AC1024 or older ACIS-carrier support through this mode
exact modern DXF version preservation on write
full block graph closure under default inlining/merge options
evidence.planUse: Keep separate optional explicit-geometry and AC1027+ raw ASM lanes. Pin version/options; disable block inlining/merging for owner checks; do not score omission-default or AC2004 output as a modern carrier round trip.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD DXF consumer profile and stock ACIS limit
evidence.observed: FreeCAD documents C++ and optional legacy Python DXF importers with differing entity coverage; the stock DXF route does not read proprietary ACIS solid blobs, and a maintainer response in #18454 describes ACIS support as unavailable in the stock FOSS route. DWG converter handoff is separate from the selected DXF importer.
doesNotEstablish: runtime acceptance for every importer/backend/release/platform tuple
that explicit geometry and ACIS bodies share support status
that a DWG converter adds ACIS support to the importer
evidence.planUse: Pin FreeCAD release, platform, importer/backend and converter for each consumer result. Mark stock ACIS as not applicable and require a named modeler path plus complete shape/analytic checks for an ACIS claim.

evidence.topic: Current peer ACIS carrier/writer loss reports remain unqualified
evidence.observed: LibreDWG #1411 remains open and reports R2013+ AcDs/SAB loss with the solid entity surviving. ACadSharp #1195 remains open and reports 3DSOLID/REGION omission, including solid-only blocks, on its stated 3.4.9 route. Linked PR #1240 remains open and undeployed, with a dependency on the ACDS/ACIS schema refactor #1174.
doesNotEstablish: current released behavior of all peer versions
ACIS semantic correctness from issue repro steps
capability from an unmerged peer branch
evidence.planUse: Retain the existing per-owner entity→carrier→emitted-record ledger and visible loss disposition. Re-pin and test any future peer release; do not import external drawings or treat issue/PR status as qualification.
